perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Centrus signed binding multi-year HALEU supply contracts with Radiant and Antares in September 2026, both including customer prepayments that support domestic enrichment-capacity expansion.
The Antares contract explicitly targets unobligated HALEU usable for space and national-security missions, broadening demand beyond civilian advanced reactors.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: On 2026-07-01 Centrus signed the DOE contract for a $900 million award supporting large-scale HALEU capacity and reported completion of an additional 900 kg of HALEU UF6 ahead of schedule.
The company has moved from demonstration-scale framing toward commercial-scale enrichment, but customer deliveries under recent contracts generally begin before decade-end rather than immediately.

risks: Commercial-scale expansion remains a capital- and execution-intensive buildout.
Recent customer contracts support demand but do not prove delivered commercial-scale volumes or margins.
A September 2026 $500 million equity/warrant offering creates dilution and capital-structure risk even as it adds funding capacity.
unknowns: Achieved commercial-scale HALEU run-rate and unit economics remain unverified here.
Exact backlog economics and customer concentration are not established by this Scout artifact.
